summary: After the accepted grow_up correction, v54 reaches a monster multishot volley. source.branch: Compute xname(obj) first. If gm.m_shot.n > 1 and gm.m_shot.o equals obj->otyp, prepend "the <i><ordin(i)> "; otherwise return the ordinary xname unchanged.
callers: mthrowu.c:thitu uses mshot_xname(obj) when the incoming object stack has quantity one; JS js/mthrowu.js:thitu already calls mshot_xname.

mthrowu.c:m_throw uses mshot_xname(singleobj) for visible sink-drop and missed-volley messages; JS js/mthrowu.js:m_throw already passes mshot_xname as distant_name callback at the corresponding output sites.

evidence: objnam.c:1090-1102 defines the whole function. C evaluates xname(obj) before testing gm.m_shot.n > 1 and matching gm.m_shot.o to obj->otyp; on the volley branch it formats "the %d%s " from gm.m_shot.i and ordin(i), prepends that prefix with strprepend, then returns the resulting name. The quantity-one branch returns xname unchanged.

Required callees are already implemented: objnam.c:xname and strprepend in js/objnam.js, and hacklib.c:ordin in js/hacklib.js. The port must preserve unconditional name construction and source order, use the current volley index/type state, and remove the existing unsupported multishot missile ordinal refusal.

evidence: At makemon.c:2095-2117, C sets unsigned fem to 0 for M2_MALE, 1 for M2_FEMALE, or mtmp->female (an integer boolean); the evolution message formats pmname(ptr, fem) and compares fem to mtmp->female at 2141-2150. PM_ELVENKING in include/monsters.h:2679-2685 has neither male nor female flags and names [Elvenking, Elvenqueen, elven monarch].

At js/makemon.js:431-451 before the fix, the fallback assigned mtmp.female directly; Boolean false/true was not an array index in js/do_name.js:1239-1244, so pmname fell back to NEUTRAL. JS also used strict number-versus-boolean comparison for the verb. The fix in 9fa6482c0 converts the fallback and comparison to C-compatible numbers and stores Boolean(fem), preserving JS game-state shape.
